problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 47 m³, revenue $126
* Package 2: volume 1 m³, revenue $122
* Package 3: volume 39 m³, revenue $208
* Package 4: volume 9 m³, revenue $139
* Package 5: volume 47 m³, revenue $293
* Package 6: volume 13 m³, revenue $74
* Package 7: volume 25 m³, revenue $299
* Package 8: volume 43 m³, revenue $255
* Package 9: volume 24 m³, revenue $250
* Package 10: volume 40 m³, revenue $79
* Package 11: volume 2 m³, revenue $212
* Package 12: volume 43 m³, revenue $226
* Package 13: volume 23 m³, revenue $168
* Package 14: volume 10 m³, revenue $158
* Package 15: volume 32 m³, revenue $143
* Package 16: volume 26 m³, revenue $133
* Package 17: volume 30 m³, revenue $113
* Package 18: volume 45 m³, revenue $103
* Package 19: volume 32 m³, revenue $243
* Package 20: volume 3 m³, revenue $219
* Package 21: volume 13 m³, revenue $279
* Package 22: volume 19 m³, revenue $227
* Package 23: volume 7 m³, revenue $168

The plane's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 401 m³. Choose the combination of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume constraint. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
